title: Kenyan Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from Kenya, typically made with meat and spices. Serve over couscous for a hearty meal.

ingredients.name: Rest of spices
ingredients.notes: a mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

ingredients.name: Tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern stores

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add meat and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add spices and cooking water to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1.5 hours.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
